name: billing-software
description: Billing Software - Full stack app (React + Express + MongoDB Atlas) for single-service Render deployment

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'frontend/dist/*' 'dist' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not (Test-Path 'dist')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'dist' | Out-Null }"
